what: counterintuitive-mechanism probe batch (2026-10-12 directive): each probe gets one focused cached or held-out test; judged by measurement only
sample: first N rows of the fixed 2,000-row RefCOCO val sample (records_refcoco_glm2000.jsonl, seed 20261010); diagnostics only -- no shipped knob is tuned here, and any promoted signal would be re-validated on train-carved rows before training
candidate_ordering: released region-text similarity (sc) top-k; tie-breaks deterministic

probes.hypothesis: A VLM can select among numbered candidate overlays (Set-of-Mark) without producing coordinates -- turning selection into a classification.
probes.test: Top-8 SAM candidates tinted and numbered; GLM-4.1V asked for the index on 5 cached RefCOCO val rows; pick = answered index (unparsed answers fall back to the released pick).
probes.outcome: Set-of-Mark mIoU 1.749 vs released-pick 35.547 on the same rows; 0/5 answers unusable (truncated thinking or no index); parsed-only mIoU 1.749.
